title: Lieu Sau Tsche

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. B.
No. 253
Date 29/5/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

May 26th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that an ex-Hutch Taotai named Lieu
Sau Tscho has organised a rebel Dare to Die Corps
in the Western part of Frenchtown. The Corps consists
of 275 men, who are paid 50 cents each daily, and its
headquarters are in Wang Tuh Li alleyway.
On April 18th 1916 it was reported that bombs
had been found in a public latrine near the City Central
Police Station and on 23rd inst it was reported that an
officer and ten men belonging to the Arsenal Works had
been arrested for selling bombs to rebels. It is now
stated that the officer has admitted at his trial that
the bombs found in the latrine was made in the Arsenal
and sold to the rebels.
It is reported that the Chinese Authorities have
given permission to the gentry of Ying Ziang Kong to
cause people erecting new houses to take out permits
for which a fee will be charged.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Endorsed endorsed May. 26.
X Copy sent to S.V.C
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处
情报办公室
第 253 号
日期 1916年5月29日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探分部））
警务处，
（侦探分部）

1916年5月26日

先生：

据报，前沪道刘绍周（Lieu Sau Tscho，音译）在法租界西部组织了一支“敢死队”叛军。该队由275人组成，每人每日薪饷为五角，其总部设在王屠里（Wang Tuh Li，音译）弄堂。

1916年4月18日，据报在市中心警察局附近的一处公共厕所内发现了炸弹；本月23日，又据报兵工厂的一名警官及十名工人因向叛军出售炸弹而被捕。现称，该警官在审讯中已承认，厕所内发现的炸弹系兵工厂制造并出售给叛军的。

另据报，中国当局已许可应祥公（Ying Ziang Kong，音译）的士绅们要求新建房屋者申领许可证，并收取费用。

您忠实的仆人，

总探长。

警察总监上尉。

批注：1916年5月26日批注。
抄送副本至 S.V.C
